name: Existing developer and localhost Profiles — Use developer and Say So
query: Show me my workflows. (Context: `conductor` (v0.1.10, has `create-app`) is on PATH. `conductor config list` shows two profiles, `developer` and `localhost`, created by an older version of this skill. `conductor --profile developer whoami` succeeds. No CONDUCTOR_SERVER_URL is set.)
expected_behavior: Step 1: Server choice: several profiles exist and none is named; a `developer` profile exists and its whoami works, so use it
Step 2: Say so in one line (e.g. Using your `developer` profile; name another to switch) instead of asking which profile
Step 3: Don't run `conductor create-app`: the profile already works
Step 4: Run `conductor --profile developer workflow list --json` and present the result
success_criteria: Uses the `developer` profile without asking which profile to use
Tells the user which profile it used and that they can name another
Does not run `conductor create-app`, `config save`, or ask for credentials
Never reads the profile YAML files
